mapper.select: SELECT GROUP_CODE, GROUP_NAME, NVL(DESCRIPTION, '') AS DESCRIPTION, SORT_ORDER, CASE WHEN ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ACTIVE, CASE WHEN SYSTEM_YN = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS SYSTEM_GROUP, VERSION_NO FROM PM_CODE_GROUP ORDER BY SORT_ORDER, GROUP_CODE
SELECT GROUP_CODE, CODE, CODE_NAME, PARENT_CODE, SORT_ORDER, CASE WHEN ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ACTIVE, VALID_FROM, VALID_TO FROM PM_COMMON_CODE ORDER BY GROUP_CODE, SORT_ORDER, CODE
mapper.update: MERGE INTO PM_CODE_GROUP target USING (SELECT #{row.groupCode} GROUP_CODE FROM DUAL) source ON (target.GROUP_CODE = source.GROUP_CODE) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET GROUP_NAME = #{row.groupName}, DESCRIPTION = #{row.description}, SORT_ORDER = #{row.sortOrder}, ACTIVE_YN = #{row.activeYn}, SYSTEM_YN = #{row.systemYn}, VERSION_NO = #{row.version}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, UPDATED_BY = 'APPLICATION' WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( GROUP_CODE, GROUP_NAME, DESCRIPTION, SORT_ORDER, ACTIVE_YN, SYSTEM_YN, VERSION_NO, CREATED_BY, UPDATED_BY ) VALUES ( #{row.groupCode}, #{row.groupName}, #{row.description}, #{row.sortOrder}, #{row.activeYn}, #{row.systemYn}, #{row.version}, 'APPLICATION', 'APPLICATION' )

MERGE INTO PM_COMMON_CODE target USING (SELECT #{row.groupCode} GROUP_CODE, #{row.code} CODE FROM DUAL) source ON (target.GROUP_CODE = source.GROUP_CODE AND target.CODE = source.CODE) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET CODE_NAME = #{row.codeName}, PARENT_CODE = #{row.parentCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SORT_ORDER = #{row.sortOrder}, ACTIVE_YN = #{row.activeYn}, VALID_FROM = #{row.validFrom}, VALID_TO = #{row.validTo}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, UPDATED_BY = 'APPLICATION' WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( GROUP_CODE, CODE, CODE_NAME, PARENT_CODE, SORT_ORDER, ACTIVE_YN, VALID_FROM, VALID_TO, CREATED_BY, UPDATED_BY ) VALUES ( #{row.groupCode}, #{row.code}, #{row.codeName}, #{row.parentCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{row.sortOrder}, #{row.activeYn}, #{row.validFrom}, #{row.validTo}, 'APPLICATION', 'APPLICATION' )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM PM_COMMON_CODE WHERE GROUP_CODE = #{groupCode} AND CODE = #{code}
